```{r}
head(results2)
```

```{r}
results2 <- results2 %>%
  left_join(
    sacks %>% select(game_id, play_uuid, sack_player, sack),
    by = c("game_id", "play_id" = "play_uuid", "rusher_name" = "sack_player")
  ) %>%
  mutate(sack = replace_na(sack, 0L)) 


results2 <- results2 %>%
  left_join(
    hits %>% select(game_id, play_uuid, hit_player, hit),
    by = c("game_id", "play_id" = "play_uuid", "rusher_name" = "hit_player")
  ) %>%
  mutate(hit = replace_na(hit, 0L))
  

results2 <- results2 %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_score = case_when(
      sack == 1L         ~ 1.0,
      hit == 1L          ~ 0.4,
      rusher_won == 1L   ~ 0.2,
      TRUE               ~ 0.0
    )
  )

print(nrow(results2))
print(sum(results2$outcome_score == 1.0)) 
print(sum(results2$outcome_score == 0.4))
print(sum(results2$outcome_score == 0.2))
print(sum(results2$outcome_score == 1.0) + sum(results2$outcome_score == 0.4) + sum(results2$outcome_score == 0.2))
```

Cleaning
```{r}
results_cleaned <- results2 %>% 
  drop_na(game_id, rusher_name, blocker_name) %>% 
  arrange(game_id, play_id, event_game_index) %>% 
  select(-sack, -hit, -rusher_won)

#results_cleaned <- results_cleaned %>%
  #left_join(outcome_summary, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "rusher_name"))

init_play_ratings <- results_cleaned %>%
  select(rusher_name, blocker_name) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "type", values_to = "player_name") %>%
  mutate(Player_Elo = ifelse(type == "rusher_name", 750, 1125)) %>%  
  distinct(player_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

elo_vec <- setNames(init_play_ratings$Player_Elo, init_play_ratings$player_name)
```


Elo function
```{r}
#adaptive learning rate from max
adaptive_K_prov <- function(n, K_start, K_min, n_prov, n_decay) {
  k <- ifelse(
    n <= n_prov,
    K_start,
    ifelse(
      n <= n_decay,
      K_start + (K_min - K_start) * (n - n_prov) / (n_decay - n_prov),
      K_min
    )
  )
  pmax(k, K_min)
}

#updated elo function to include K and double teams
elo_step <- function(
  belo, relo, outcome_score, blocker_K, rusher_K,
  double_team, scale = 319
) {
  if (is.na(outcome_score)) return(c(b = belo, r = relo))

  blocker_bonus <- ifelse(double_team == 1, 100, 0)
  adj_belo <- belo + blocker_bonus

  #calc based on rusher win prob
  exp_rusher <- 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((adj_belo - relo) / scale))

  #rusher rewarded when they win; blocker rewarded when rusher fails
  c(
    b = belo + blocker_K * ((1 - outcome_score) - (1 - exp_rusher)), 
    r = relo + rusher_K  * ( outcome_score      -      exp_rusher)   
  )
}

get_elo <- function(id) {
  id <- as.character(id)  
  if (!id %in% names(elo_vec)) elo_vec[[id]] <- 1000
  return(elo_vec[[id]])
} 

```

```{r}
results_cleaned <- as.data.table(results_cleaned)

results_cleaned <- results_cleaned %>%
  group_by(rusher_name) %>%
  mutate(rusher_row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(blocker_name) %>%
  mutate(blocker_row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

#compute k for rusher and blocker
results_cleaned <- results_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    rusher_k = adaptive_K_prov(n = rusher_row, K_start = 20, K_min = 10, n_prov = 87, n_decay = 200),
    blocker_k = adaptive_K_prov(blocker_row, K_start = 20, K_min = 10, n_prov = 87, n_decay = 200)
  )
```


```{r}

interaction_counts <- list()  # Initialize interaction count
elo_vec <- setNames(init_play_ratings$Player_Elo, init_play_ratings$player_name)

elo_history <- results_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    before_rusher_elo = NA_real_,
    before_blocker_elo = NA_real_,
    after_rusher_elo = NA_real_,
    after_blocker_elo = NA_real_,
    rusher_n           = rusher_row,
    blocker_n          = blocker_row
  )

for (i in seq_len(nrow(results_cleaned))) {
  r_id <- results_cleaned$rusher_name[i]
  b_id <- results_cleaned$blocker_name[i]
  out  <- results_cleaned$outcome_score[i]
  r_K  <- results_cleaned$rusher_k[i]
  b_K  <- results_cleaned$blocker_k[i]
  d_t <- results_cleaned$double_team[i]

  if (is.na(r_id) || is.na(b_id) || is.na(out)) next

  r_elo <- get_elo(r_id)
  b_elo <- get_elo(b_id)

  elo_history$before_rusher_elo[i]  <- r_elo
  elo_history$before_blocker_elo[i] <- b_elo

  new <- elo_step(b_elo, r_elo, outcome_score = out, blocker_K = b_K, rusher_K = r_K, double_team = d_t)

  if (!any(is.na(new))) {
  elo_vec[[r_id]] <- new["r"]
  elo_vec[[b_id]] <- new["b"]
}

  elo_history$after_rusher_elo[i]  <- new["r"]
  elo_history$after_blocker_elo[i] <- new["b"]
}

```

```{r}
# memory cleanup: remove initial ratings after vector creation
rm(init_play_ratings)
gc()
```

```{r}
#get results
elo_df <- enframe(elo_vec, name = "player_name", value = "final_elo")

#differentiate between rushers and blockers
player_roles <- results_cleaned %>%
  select(rusher_name, blocker_name) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), values_to = "player_name") %>%
  mutate(role = ifelse(name == "rusher_name", "Rusher", "Blocker")) %>%
  distinct(player_name, role)

#join to get elo with annotated rusher/blocker label
elo_labeled <- elo_df %>%
  left_join(player_roles, by = "player_name") %>%
  filter(!is.na(role))

#get top 10
top_rushers <- elo_labeled %>%
  filter(role == "Rusher") %>%
  slice_max(final_elo, n = 12)

top_blockers <- elo_labeled %>%
  filter(role == "Blocker") %>%
  slice_max(final_elo, n = 12)
```

```{r}
#pivot to get elo updates per play 
elo_long <- elo_history %>%
  select(game_id, play_id,
         rusher_name, blocker_name,
         after_rusher_elo, after_blocker_elo,
         rusher_n, blocker_n) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(after_rusher_elo, after_blocker_elo),
    names_to = "elo_type",
    values_to = "elo"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    player_name = ifelse(elo_type == "after_rusher_elo", rusher_name, blocker_name),
    interaction_n = ifelse(elo_type == "after_rusher_elo", rusher_n, blocker_n),
    role = ifelse(elo_type == "after_rusher_elo", "Rusher", "Blocker")
  ) %>%
  select(play_id, game_id, player_name, role, interaction_n, elo) %>%
  filter(!is.na(elo))

final_elos <- elo_long %>%
  group_by(player_name, role) %>%
  filter(interaction_n == max(interaction_n, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Select top 10 per role based on final Elo
top_players <- final_elos %>%
  group_by(role) %>%
  filter(interaction_n > 200) %>% 
  slice_max(elo, n = 10) %>%
  pull(player_name)

elo_top <- elo_long %>%
  filter(player_name %in% top_players)
```

Log loss validation
```{r}
n_total <- nrow(elo_history)
n_train <- floor(0.8 * n_total)

train_df <- elo_history[1:n_train, ]
test_df  <- elo_history[(n_train + 1):n_total, ]

final_rusher_elo <- train_df %>%
  group_by(rusher_name) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  select(rusher_name, after_rusher_elo) %>%
  rename(rusher_elo_pred = after_rusher_elo)

final_blocker_elo <- train_df %>%
  group_by(blocker_name) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  select(blocker_name, after_blocker_elo) %>%
  rename(blocker_elo_pred = after_blocker_elo)

test_df <- test_df %>%
  left_join(final_rusher_elo, by = "rusher_name") %>%
  left_join(final_blocker_elo, by = "blocker_name")

baseline_mean <- mean(train_df$outcome_score != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
test_df$baseline_pred <- baseline_mean

scale <- 319
test_df$blocker_bonus <- ifelse(test_df$double_team == 1, 100, 0)
test_df$adj_belo <- test_df$blocker_elo_pred + test_df$blocker_bonus

test_df$rusher_win_prob <- 1 / (1 + 10^((test_df$adj_belo - test_df$rusher_elo_pred) / scale))


test_df$blocker_bonus <- ifelse(test_df$double_team == 1, 100, 0)
test_df$adj_belo <- test_df$before_blocker_elo + test_df$blocker_bonus

test_df$updating_pred <- 1 / (1 + 10^((test_df$adj_belo - test_df$before_rusher_elo) / scale))

# --- Compute MSE ---
mse_base         <- mean((test_df$baseline_pred - test_df$outcome_score)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
mse_elo          <- mean((test_df$rusher_win_prob - test_df$outcome_score)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
mse_updating_elo <- mean((test_df$updating_pred - test_df$outcome_score)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Baseline MSE:", mse_base, "\n")
cat("ELO MSE:", mse_elo, "\n")
cat("Updating ELO MSE:", mse_updating_elo, "\n")
```

```{r}
data_1 <- results2 %>% 
  select(-V1) %>% 
  mutate(
    rusher_name = factor(rusher_name),
    blocker_name = factor(blocker_name),
    rusher_won = factor(rusher_won)
  ) %>% 
  select(rusher_won, rusher_name, blocker_name, double_team)

data_1 <- data_1[complete.cases(data_1), ]

y <- data_1$rusher_won

X <- model.matrix(rusher_won ~ rusher_name + blocker_name + double_team, data = data_1)[,-1]

fit_glm <- cv.glmnet(X,y,type.measure = "deviance", alpha = 0, family = "binomial")

plot(fit_glm)

min_lambda <- fit_glm$lambda.min


coef_df <- as.matrix(coef(fit_glm, s = min_lambda))

coef_df <- data.frame(
  variable = rownames(coef_df),
  coefficient = coef_df[,1],
  row.names = NULL
)


coef_df <- coef_df %>% filter(variable != "(Intercept)")


coef_df <- coef_df %>%
  mutate(
    variable = str_remove(variable, "^rusher_name"),
    variable = str_remove(variable, "^blocker_name")
  )

```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=6}
names <- fread('../../nfl_data/Hudl IQ 2021 player roster.csv')
results <- coef_df %>% 
  left_join(names, by = c("variable" = "player_name"))

results <- results %>% 
  mutate(
    Offense = ifelse(team_position_name %in% c("Offensive Lineman", "Tight End"), TRUE, FALSE),
    Defense = ifelse(team_position_name %in% c("Defensive Lineman", "Linebacker"), TRUE, FALSE)
  )

n_interactions_rusher <- data_1 %>% 
  group_by(rusher_name) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

n_interactions_blocker <- data_1 %>% 
  group_by(blocker_name) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

qualified_rusher <- n_interactions_rusher %>% 
  filter(count > 199) %>% 
  pull(rusher_name)

qualified_blocker <- n_interactions_blocker %>% 
  filter(count > 199) %>% 
  pull(blocker_name)

best_blockers <- results %>% 
  filter(Offense==T & variable %in% qualified_blocker) %>% 
  arrange(-desc(coefficient)) %>% 
  select(variable,coefficient,player_id) %>% 
  unique()

best_rushers <- results %>% 
  filter(Defense==T & variable %in% qualified_rusher) %>% 
  arrange(desc(coefficient)) %>%
```
